items.name: df_result
items.summary: This macro is a helpful conversion utility to convert from an FFI_Result to a DataFusion result.

items.name: sresult
items.summary: This macro is a helpful conversion utility to convert from a DataFusion Result to an FFI_Result.

items.name: sresult_return
items.summary: This macro is a helpful conversion utility to convert from a DataFusion Result to an FFI_Result and to also call return when it is an error. Since you cannot use `?` on an FFI_Result, this is designed to mimic the pattern.
